sys_script_include.description: Builds the outbound VAMP payload (envelope plus one finding element) for an application vulnerable item. Sections and their fields come from the properties usem.vamp.avit.sections and usem.vamp.avit.fields.<section>.
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor

sys_script_include.description: Sends a VAMP payload to the Kafka topic held in usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id with sn_ih_kafka.ProducerV2 (key <table>.<sys_id>). Documentation of API used - https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/server-api-reference/ProducerV2ScopedAPI.html
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp

sys_properties.description: sys_id of the Kafka Topic record [sys_kafka_topic] for sn_usem_verification_outbound, read by BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id

sys_properties.description: Sections of the VAMP finding payload in order, one json_key=path per line: the path is dot-walked from the application vulnerable item (empty path = the item itself, remediation_task = the item's remediation task). The fields of each section come from usem.vamp.avit.fields.<json_key>.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.sections
sys_properties.value: finding=, tpe=vulnerability, remediation_task=remediation_task, ait=application_release.u_primary_ait, ci=cmdb_ci, exception=change_approval, consequence=u_consequence, ptreq=assessment_request,

sys_properties.description: Fields of the finding section (sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item), one servicenow_field=json_field per line in payload order; a field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.finding
sys_properties.value: number=number, sys_created_on=sys_created_on, sys_updated_on=sys_updated_on, state=state, cmdb_ci=configuration_item, u_verification_status=u_verification_status, source_avit_id=source_avit_id,

sys_properties.description: Fields of the tpe section (third party entry, sn_vul_app_vul_entry), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.tpe

sys_properties.description: Fields of the remediation_task section (sn_vul_app_vulnerability), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.remediation_task

sys_properties.description: Fields of the ait section (Primary AIT of the finding), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.ait

sys_properties.description: Fields of the ci section (configuration item of the finding), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.ci

sys_properties.description: Fields of the exception section (sn_sec_exception_change_approval), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.exception

sys_properties.description: Fields of the consequence section, one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.consequence

sys_properties.description: Fields of the ptreq section (sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request), one servicenow_field=json_field per line.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.avit.fields.ptreq

sys_script.description: Builds the VAMP payload for the application vulnerable item with BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor and sends it with BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp on every insert and update.
sys_script.name: BOFA_BR_AVIT_VampOutbound
